en: Shall we V? / Shall I V? (suggestion)

examples.en: Shall we work out together?
What shall we do tonight?
Shall we go to a café together?
Shall we watch a movie together?
Shall we meet at Gangnam Station tomorrow?
Shall we do our homework together? — Sure.

explain: “-(으)ㄹ까요?”는 “같이 할까요?”(shall we)와 “제가 할까요?”(shall I)의 두 가지 뜻이 있어요. 대답은 “좋아요”나 “그래요”로 해요.
explain_en: -(으)ㄹ까요? can mean “shall we?” or “shall I?”. Answer with 좋아요 or 그래요.
